facts.name: Mary P. Hatcher
facts.assignment: Domestic relations, juvenile dependency, unified family court and probate under S-2025-58-A effective June29,2026. Basic noncommercial review.

contact.contact_note: Office/assistant shared telephone; personal judicial email not established.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File first, coordinate parties and use family/probate OnceHub routes; wait for confirmation before notice. Email assistant for longer/uncoordinated requests and dependency scheduling. Email-coordinated settings require notice within24hours of reconfirmation; no cross-notice without approval.

proposed_orders.summary: Family/dependency: editable Word orders by email to assistant using posted formatting guide and complete service certificate. Probate: US Mail only to assistant, with cover letter and portal-stamped checklist/motion or petition; do not email or portal-file proposed probate orders. File original wills/death certificates with clerk.

remote_appearances.summary: Profile requires in-person attendance at noticed location and states Zoom appearances are not permitted.

chambers_communications.summary: Assistant email is for scheduling, submissions and court operations; file merits communications with clerk and provide copies to interested parties. No ex parte discussion.

courtesy_copies.summary: Probate non-evidence hearing notebooks, such as authorities, go in hard copy at least five days ahead; retain division link for specific instructions.

cancellations.summary: Notify office promptly and file appropriate notice/motion; requested continuance does not remove hearing absent court approval or confirmation.

facts.summary: Confirmed coordinated scheduling, in-person attendance, emailed family/dependency Word orders and separate mailed probate-order route.

review_scope.collected: Complete official profile HTML and extracted text; linked guide/scheduling URLs; reused assignment order.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts, assignment and basic general/division scheduling, submission, appearance and communication routes.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Family final-judgment checklist, dependency litigation standards/transport details, probate merits and detailed forms; formatting-guide link retained without downloading because basic submission route is explicit.

gaps: No personal judicial email or distinct assistant-only telephone established.
